metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-9t[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Require descriptions for every AXE lumberjack and chop[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every configured lumberjack and every chop carries a non-blank [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`description`, enforced fail-closed by the shared config authority,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]supplied by all first-party and user-owned configs, and shown [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]prominently in a dedicated always-visible banner on the ACE AXE tab[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]whenever a lumberjack or chop row is selected.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]axe_required_descriptions.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core accepts lumberjack descriptions and can require them[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core_description_support[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase 1 — Rust core description support' section: teach sase_core's AXE[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]validator about `lumberjacks.<name>.description`, add non-blank [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]validation for both lumberjack and chop descriptions, and implement an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]opt-in `require_descriptions` flag on the validation, compose, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]entry-mutation wires that defaults to false so the release stays [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]backwards compatible.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Plumb optional descriptions through sase and describe the [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]builtin lumberjacks[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]sase_optional_description[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core_description_support[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase 2 — Optional descriptions in sase' section: bump the sase-core-rs[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]window, add `description` to LumberjackConfig and the lumberjack JSON [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]schema as an optional field, parse it, expose it on the AXE display [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshots, and give all five builtin lumberjacks in default_config.yml a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]description. No enforcement yet.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Describe every lumberjack and chop in chezmoi and bugyi-chops[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]external_configs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sase_optional_description[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase 3 — External and user-owned configs' section: add descriptions to[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every lumberjack and chop configured in the chezmoi repo's sase.yml and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase_athena.yml, and to the YAML examples in the bugyi-chops README, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the user's machines stay valid once enforcement is switched on.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]AXE tab description banner[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]axe_tab_banner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sase_optional_description[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase 4 — AXE tab description banner' section: add an always-visible [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]AxeDescriptionBanner widget between the AXE status bar and the scrolling[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]output pane that shows the selected lumberjack's or chop's description, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wire it through the dashboard update paths, style it, and cover it with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unit and PNG snapshot tests.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Surface descriptions in the AXE CLI listings[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]cli_surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sase_optional_description[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase 5 — CLI surfaces' section: print the lumberjack description in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase axe lumberjack list` and promote the chop Description column in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase axe chop list` from verbose-only to always shown.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Enforce required descriptions and document the contract[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]enforce_required[dim] · [dim][/dim]after external_configs, cli_surfaces[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase 6 — Enforce required descriptions' section: flip [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`require_descriptions` on in the sase compose and mutation requests, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mark description required in the JSON schema, drop the LumberjackConfig [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]default, update every in-repo config fixture and test, and document the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]new contract.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
